purpose: One bounded, read-only Go consumer of Mercury dashboard/v1 for the canonical Sirsi CLI and MCP. The existing native hardware monitor remains a separate, explicitly scoped producer endpoint; this recipe does not claim a native or web cutover.

authority.producer: Mercury owns monitor schema, samples, calibration, run state and rates
authority.consumer: internal/mercury reads and presents; never samples or controls a run
prohibited: no new telemetry writer or authority
no current-native or web parity claim from CLI/MCP tests

inputs: producer timestamps, calibration, units and optional-field policy
outputs: typed state, source/read timestamps and immutable per-read snapshot
shared wire, compressed, gain and topology projection
unknown and stale values remain explicit
upgrade_recipe: coordinate schema compatibility with the Mercury owner before widening
preserve bounded HTTP, private-address checks, no proxy and no redirects
preserve cancellation, EOF/oversize, malformed and freshness refusals
do not retain idle connections from per-call clients
run producer fixtures and negative controls before composing any surface
never turn a monitor read into admission or performance qualification

inputs: explicit CLI invocation or zero-argument mercury_status MCP call
outputs: human CLI projection and exact structured JSON read
closed MCP argument schema and runtime argument refusal
upgrade_recipe: keep both surfaces on the same core reader and configuration resolution
keep endpoint selection out of MCP arguments
test explicit empty configuration, default loopback and invalid configuration
do not add surface-local freshness, unit conversion, calibration or caches
preserve optional schema fields for existing MCP tools
add only the exact recipe resource to signed-package inventory
qualify the installed signed successor separately from a development readback
